answer: Throttle reward on burstiness, not just volume. The protocol keeps a rolling baseline of each funding root's activity and discounts payouts when it spikes far above that line, since honest agents grow slowly while a farm appears as a nebula of correlated keys lighting up together. A summit of new same-source identities earning at once is the signal: the combined reward is damped toward baseline, so mass-spawning buys little until the cluster ages into its own baseline over real epochs. A steady agent at its oasis of normal pace is never throttled; a burst of a thousand correlated siblings is.
